entries.caption: I need help.
entries.description: Urgent request for assistance. Closed fist with thumb extended upward resting on open palm of non-dominant hand, lifting slightly together.

entries.caption: I need water.
entries.description: Request for drinking water. Three fingers (index, middle, ring) held upright in 'W' shape tapped near mouth or chin.

entries.caption: I need food.
entries.description: Request for meal or food nourishment. Flattened O-handshape with fingertips brought toward lips or mouth repeatedly.

entries.caption: I am in pain.
entries.description: Indication of physical distress or localized pain. Index fingers pointed toward each other and twisted or jabbed slightly near area of discomfort.

entries.caption: I need a doctor.
entries.description: Request for medical doctor or physician assistance. Bent fingertips (M-hand or bent hand) tapping radial artery pulse point on inner wrist.

entries.caption: I need medicine.
entries.description: Request for medication or prescription. Middle finger tip pivoting in circular motion on palm of non-dominant hand as if grinding mortar and pestle.

entries.caption: I need the washroom.
entries.description: Request to use restroom or washroom facilities. 'T' handshape (thumb between index and middle fingers) shaken gently side to side.

entries.caption: Yes.
entries.description: Affirmation or agreement. Closed fist nodding up and down from wrist imitating head nod.

entries.caption: No.
entries.description: Negation or refusal. Index and middle fingers snapping down onto thumb repeatedly.

entries.caption: Please repeat.
entries.description: Request for repetition or re-signing. Bent open hand moving in an arc back towards the body or flipping over palm-up.

entries.caption: Thank you.
entries.description: Expression of gratitude. Flat open hand with fingertips touching chin or lips, moving outward toward the other person.
Rest position, neutral hand posture, or absence of active vocabulary gesture. Suppresses caption rendering and audio playback.
